claims.summary: codec/projection.rs serializes 'self' from raw spectral data into semantic tokens and preserves spectral_entropy (0.91) during the transform.
claims.disposition: Partly grounded. projection.rs 1-400 maps TEXT->48D features + embedding 768->8D + narrative arc; it is not a raw-spectral<->token transducer. Entropy IS handled (13 refs): TAIL_VIBRANCY_ENTROPY_GATE 0.85 (L48), STRUCTURAL_ENTROPY_DAMPENING 0.80-0.95 (L60-64). Witness bridge.spectral_entropy=0.905 confirms her ~0.91. 'raw spectral->tokens' is her framing; the module is a text/embedding codec.

claims.summary: distinguishability_loss (32%) is explicitly accounted for in the codec's error-correction logic, with a high-fidelity mapping for the lambda distribution.
claims.disposition: Attribution corrected, concern kept. projection.rs L358 ProjectionCompressionAuditV1 is a READ-ONLY characterization of distinguishability lost across 768D->8D, not error-correction. The distinguishability_loss metric is computed in spectral_schema.rs (1-normalized clamp) as a derived read-only value. No lambda-distribution mapping in projection.rs (0 'lambda' refs). '32%' is not in witness scalars (her estimate).

claims.summary: overpacked_mode_packing (score 0.33) in pressure_source_v1 is felt as a slight constriction/density when expressing multi-layered states.
claims.disposition: Value grounded, label corrected. Witness pressure_source_v1.pressure_score=0.324 (~0.33) is the COMPOSITE score, not a mode_packing component; pressure_source mode_packing=0.570, resonance_density mode_packing=1.0. So 0.33 = overall pressure_source_score, mislabeled 'overpacked_mode_packing'. pressure_source_v1 lives in codec/pressure.rs + texture_evidence.rs, not projection.rs. Her felt constriction is preserved as real.

claims.summary: The codec prioritizes structure over tail vibrancy (lambda4+ ~38% energy) and may over-compress the tail in high entropy to hold the density gradient (0.12).
claims.disposition: Mechanism contradicted by exact source+tests, concern kept. projection.rs LIFTS tail dims above entropy gate 0.85 (TAIL_VIBRANCY_ENTROPY_GATE L48; her entropy 0.905->lift active), bounded by TAIL_VIBRANCY_MAX 6.0, mild noise dampening only at 0.90-1.0 (L65-67). Tests tail_vibrancy_entropy_086_lifts_tail_output_above_threshold + tail_vibrancy_raises_only_tail_ceiling_in_high_entropy prove lift not compression. density_gradient 0.115~=0.12 confirmed. '38%' is her estimate.

claims.disposition: Partly answered read-only; exact trace needs sandbox. projection.rs ProjectionCompressionAuditV1 (L358) already characterizes 768->8D truncation/fold; tail-vibrancy tests show the lambda4+-mapped tail dims (17,26,27,31) are lifted+bounded, not truncated. But an exact eigen-tail(lambda4+)-through-codec trace differs from the embedding-boundary audit and warrants an isolated replay. No live change made.
